scope: General NewObject/NewObjectV/NewObjectA constructor bridge and shared class lookup; no package or application-specific behavior.

basis.implementation: Independent implementation of JNI/API and AAPCS64 contracts; no JDK/ART implementation code copied.

observed_blocker.prior_observation: Exact Candy startup stopped on missing slot29 after an earlier optional or required Thread FindClass failure. These logs do not identify the NewObject constructor class/descriptor.
observed_blocker.return: Both prior application cases returned to launcher with matching installation identity; SD restored.

implementation.constructor: All three entry points decode the resolved JNI descriptor, require a matching instance <init>/void signature and exact allocated/declaring class, reject abstract/interface classes, run existing class initialization before allocation, attach shared host state and execute the actual DEX constructor.
implementation.roots: The real receiver is added to local JNI references synchronously before host attachment/constructor callbacks. Failed construction deletes the temporary receiver reference; a real constructor Throwable becomes the existing pending Java exception and returns NULL.
implementation.varargs: Compiler va_copy/va_arg handle AAPCS64 save areas/stack and C default promotions. No guessed raw va_list layout is used. AArch64 static assertions check32-byte size and8-byte alignment. A uses exact union members, including narrow integers and float.
implementation.lookup: FindClass uses the shared DEX/builtin registry plus validated array components and255-dimension bound. Shared Object root and empty Runnable superinterface facts replace the old JNI-only whitelist without creating new implementations of unavailable methods.
implementation.diagnostics: Failed constructor attempts record bounded declaring class/name/descriptor metadata for subsequent exact-NRO diagnosis.
implementation.bounds: Existing JNI descriptor argument buffer bounds each native callback to128 parameters; unavailable method/constructor metadata is not synthesized.

checks.name: normal_sdk_ndk_and_actual_jvm_jni_oracle
checks.result: NewObject/NewObjectV/NewObjectA mixed arguments and constructor exceptions/native catches/reentry run on actual OpenJDK JNI. Four further JVM rows establish initialize-once and first/persistent initialization-failure reference behavior.

checks.name: portable_real_dex_constructor
checks.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p as-switch-smoke --features portable-tests --test jni_constructor -- --test-threads=1
checks.result: Actual no_std VM DEX constructors, wide/FP/object/array values, nested native-entry model, GC/root release, constructor Throwable, abstract/interface/inherited-constructor/descriptor failures, shared type lookup, initialize-once and poisoned initialization. Native callback transport is explicitly modeled in this host test.

checks.name: actual_cross_compiler_ARM64_CPU_ABI
checks.result: NDK Clang19 caller invokes actual production NewObject/A/V entry points compiled by devkitA64 GCC15.2.0. Real ARM64 instructions cover GP/FP register exhaustion, stack/narrow/promoted/wide/reference arguments and pending-exception refusal; Rust dispatch is modeled.

checks.command: cargo clippy -p as-switch-smoke --features portable-tests --lib --test jni_constructor -- -D warnings

checks.name: format_and_diff
checks.command: rustfmt --edition2021 scoped Rust files; git diff --check scoped tracked files

fixture.device_proof: Ordinary SDK Activity invokes all three JNI forms, constructor exceptions/native catches and nested JNI+GC; writes VFS result and visible TextView. It still requires actual new-NRO execution.

limitations: No complete JNI compliance or complete builtin-method metadata registry is claimed. Platform constructors absent from existing GetMethodID metadata remain unavailable.
Existing GetMethodID class-initialization side effects are retained; the portable constructor helper separately verifies the same initialization engine before allocation.
CPU ABI oracle, JVM JNI oracle and portable DEX tests are independent scopes; none replaces actual new-NRO emulator or physical-device execution.
No proprietary APK bytes, source or title-specific branches are included.
